text: Gomɗii ɓee hoɗuɓe e koɗooli mofte adinooɓe ɓen tooñuɓe fewjii fii warugol Annabiijo Muhammadu (yo o his), ɓe bonna fii noddaandu makko ndun. Alla non no anndi fii fewjoore maɓɓe nden, huunde suuɗaaki Mo e mayre, fewjoore maɓɓe ko lo'unde; nde irtirtaa lo'ere mayre pelle maa goɗɗum goo, yeeso fewjoore Alla nden e maɓɓe.
